query: I just added a new settings panel to the editor UI. Please audit the components and make sure nothing bypasses our factories.
expected_behavior: Loads the inventory from .claude/component-inventory.md and echoes a one-line summary of target files and bypass-pattern count plus the resolved arguments (auditor=claude, rounds=1, breadth=medium)
Runs the audit in a read-only Explore agent with the filled audit prompt from references/audit-prompt.md, not in the main context
Classifies each finding into the five buckets (bypass, extend factory, factory candidate, legitimate exception, exception re-examined) and applies the refactors in the same turn
Updates the inventory for every extended or new factory and every accepted, narrowed or struck exception
Runs the inventory's recommended verification command and only commits a refactor-only commit when it is green

query: Check our dashboard for duplicated UI construction. We don't have a component inventory yet.
expected_behavior: Detects that neither an argument path, .claude/component-inventory.md nor COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md exists and offers to bootstrap an inventory
Surveys the target files and drafts the inventory following inventory-template.md (target files, factories, layout contracts, grep recipes, exceptions, verification command)
Checks with git check-ignore whether .claude/ is ignored and chooses COMPONENT_INVENTORY.md in the project root if it is
Shows the draft to the user for review and does not run the audit against the unreviewed inventory
Reads references/codex-auditor.md, verifies codex --version and login, and echoes the active model from ~/.codex/config.toml with the resolved arguments before the first round

Writes the Codex preamble plus the filled audit prompt to a temp file and runs codex exec -s read-only with stdin from that file, wrapped in a git status --porcelain before/after guard and a 10-minute ceiling
Captures the thread_id from the thread.started event and resumes the same session with -c sandbox_mode="read-only" and a short re-audit prompt in rounds 2..N
Updates the inventory and commits separately between rounds, logging accepted and rejected Codex findings in the commit body
Stops when a round reports zero substantial findings or after 3 rounds, and treats any auditor write or timeout as a failed round
